title: L'Oréal, Walgreens back China biomaterials startup PAM2L in $30M round - Dealroom
summary: L'Oréal, Walgreens back China biomaterials startup PAM2L in $30M round Dealroom
ai_summary: L'Oréal and Walgreens invest in China biomaterials startup PAM2L, contributing to a $30M funding round. The partnership highlights a focus on innovative materials within the beauty and health sectors.
